sheet:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: production sprite atlas for Korean elementary school AI ethics RPG, matching STYLE REFERENCE Image 1 (the girl): polished 16-bit pixel art, clearly stepped pixel edges, dark brown outlines, warm colors, cute large heads and compact bodies, consistent pixel scale, no painterly rendering. Produce ONE transparent sprite sheet on a PORTRAIT canvas aspect ratio 4:5. EXACTLY 4 EQUAL COLUMNS and 5 EQUAL ROWS, 20 cells, invisible regular grid, each sprite centered within its own cell with generous 12% cell padding, no overlaps, NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO GRID LINES, NO SHADOWS, no ground, real transparent background. Rows 1-4 are SAME full-body character with same size and outfit, feet at same relative baseline. Row1 face FRONT/down, row2 face LEFT, row3 face RIGHT, row4 face BACK/up. Four columns in each of rows1-4 are distinct WALK CYCLE frames: left foot forward, feet together, right foot forward, feet together with slight opposite arm swing. In back view show back of head and clothing, NO face. Row5 is four head-and-shoulders DIALOGUE portraits of same character, facing slightly right: col1 calm neutral, col2 cheerful smile, col3 worried eyebrows, col4 explaining with mouth slightly open. These must be 16 separate walk frames plus 4 portrait expressions, not repeated standing clones. Do not add any other sprites or ornaments. Reference character is a style guide, use the character identity specified below.

Minjun: 14-year-old boy, same stylized big-head compact-body proportions as the pack characters. Quiet, calm face with slightly sleepy half-lidded eyes. Short, slightly tousled blue-black hair (dark navy-blue sheen). Charcoal gray zip-up hoodie worn open over a plain white T-shirt, black jogger pants, white and gray sneakers, small dark green crossbody pouch. Distinct from Haneul (black hair, burgundy windbreaker) and Onyu (glasses, teal sweater vest): NO glasses, NO vest, NO burgundy, NO teal.
sleep: Create ONE isolated sleeping character sprite, transparent background, no furniture. Image 1 is the STYLE REFERENCE; image 2 is Minjun's exact identity and outfit reference. Same 16-bit pixel art, stepped edges, dark brown outlines, restrained shading, large head compact body. Minjun: 14-year-old boy, same stylized big-head compact-body proportions as the pack characters. Quiet, calm face with slightly sleepy half-lidded eyes. Short, slightly tousled blue-black hair (dark navy-blue sheen). Charcoal gray zip-up hoodie worn open over a plain white T-shirt, black jogger pants, white and gray sneakers, small dark green crossbody pouch. Distinct from Haneul (black hair, burgundy windbreaker) and Onyu (glasses, teal sweater vest): NO glasses, NO vest, NO burgundy, NO teal. Pose: Minjun seated facing UP/away from viewer, seen from behind and slightly above, torso leaning far forward, head buried face-down into two folded forearms laid horizontally at desk-top height. The crown and back of his navy head are visible; no visible face. Elbows out left/right, forearms folded under head at upper part of silhouette. His charcoal hoodie back and seated hips visible below head. Compact seated pose, hips at bottom center, legs tucked forward and mostly occluded. Draw PERSON ONLY: desk and chair are provided by the game map, so absolutely NO desk, chair, floor, shadow, text or props outside his clothing. Crossbody pouch at hip. Portrait 3:4 canvas with generous transparent margin. Sprite will be fitted into 96x128 pixels with seated hips near (48,120). Keep clear pixel clusters, match image 2 closely.
